text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert - APAC-east edge gateway (gw-apac-e-01) elevated 5xx rate across api-proxy. Current: 7.1% (threshold 5%). Alert: https://pager.example/alerts/AE-9321

alice.k: I'm oncall, grabbing it. Anyone seen related deploys?

dinesh.s: Not from infra deploys. Looks like connection errors to model-backend pool. KV cache miss spikes too.

ben.t: seeing timeouts in envoy: `upstream_request_timeout` increasing. Logs: `` 2026-06-11T02:45:12Z gw-apac-e-01 envoy [warning] upstream request timeout id=0x2f4 ``

carla.p: tagging customer-impact. Which customers are hitting apac-east? Need list for comms.

eva.m: prod-routing shows ~18% of global traffic to apac-east, mostly APAC tenants + some EU via geo-fallback.

alice.k: immediate mitigation plan: 1) try circuit-breaker reset on gw-apac-e-01 2) scale gateway pool 3) start redirect of non-APAC traffic to apac-west as fallback. Will coordinate.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: edge-gateway-fallback-v2. Steps: `hpa scale`, `traffic-controller reroute`, `envoy reload`. See: https://runbooks.example/edge-gateway-fallback-v2

alice.k: dinesh can you check model-backend pool health? If it's the backend saturating, reroute won't help much.

dinesh.s: backend CPU/latency trending up. One host shows repeated `OOMKilled` in kube events. Running: `kubectl -n inference describe pod model-backend-5f7b`

ben.t: scaling gateway now: `kubectl -n edge scale deployment gw-apac-e --replicas=8` (was 4). Pushing an immediate increase to reduce queuing.

carla.p: I'm pulling impacted customer list from traffic logs: `SELECT tenant_id FROM access_logs WHERE region='apac-east' AND timestamp>now()-10m LIMIT 200` - will post names in a min.

alice.k: I'm doing a quick env proxy circuit reset: `curl -X POST https://envoy-admin/gw-apac-e-01/reset-circuits` (internal).

ben.t: reset returned 200, circuits reopened. Observing dropped connections drop ~10s after. Error rate dipped from 7.1% -> 5.4% then back to 6.0%.

dinesh.s: backend pod that OOMed is on node with tcmalloc OOM pattern. Killed pod recreated but memory growth is suspicious. Increasing backend replicas from 6 -> 9 while we investigate. `kubectl -n inference scale deploy model-backend --replicas=9`

eva.m: customer list: tenant-alpha, acme-asia, partners-intl, edu-svc-apac. High-traffic customers: tenant-alpha and acme-asia. Suggest informing support + account teams.

carla.p: pinging CS/AM for those tenants now. Draft comm: "We're investigating elevated error rates in APAC-east for inference traffic; we've applied mitigations including scaling and partial reroute. Monitoring closely."

alice.k: starting traffic-controller reroute of non-APAC traffic away from apac-east to apac-west. Using gradual 20% steps to avoid overwhelming target. Command: ``curl -X POST https://traffic-controller/api/v1/reroute -d '{"from":"apac-east","to":"apac-west","pct":20}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ********'``

ops-runbook-bot: Warning: Ensure apac-west model-backend capacity >= expected load before >50% reroute.

ben.t: confirm apac-west backend headroom: cpu usage 45%, replicas 10, avg latency 120ms. Looks safe for staged reroute.

alice.k: executing 20% -> wait 2m -> observe.

(alice.k reacts :white_check_mark:)

5m later...

ben.t: after 40% staged reroute errors fell to 2.3% region-wide, apac-east specifically down to 1.8%. Latency in apac-west increased 20ms but within SLO.

dinesh.s: OOM pattern analysis: a recent model rollout (tag v2.4.1) has a memory leak at specific request size. I'm pinning apac-backend to v2.4.0 for now. `kubectl set image deploy/model-backend model-backend=registry/...:v2.4.0`

carla.p: CS updated major tenants with status note. Support triage pages created.

eva.m: adding note to incident doc: https://incidents.example/1875004321

alice.k: handing primary to carla for next 2h while I finish postmortem draft. Carla, you have the oncall token and can escalate if we need cross-region capacity increases.

carla.p: taking primary. Thanks Alice. I'll keep running the reroute and watch for regression windows.

ben.t: can we keep a temporary increased autoscaling buffer on apac-west until next deploy? Suggest HPA max replicas +30% for 1h.

carla.p: applied: `kubectl patch hpa model-backend -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":13}}'`

ops-runbook-bot: Incident status: mitigated (errors reduced, fallback stable). Next steps: root-cause analysis, revert pinned image after fix, schedule change control for model rollout.

carla.p: logging handoff: current state = mitigated, under observation, oncall=carla.p, escalation path unchanged. If error rate >4% for 10m, page infra-sre and platform lead.

alice.k: thx team. I'll finish postmortem skeleton and send to #postmortems. Good job on quick coordination. :thumbsup:

carla.p: will update incident timeline and close when stable for 1hr.

incident-bot: Incident 1875004321 status changed to MONITORED by carla.p at 2026-06-11T03:05:05Z

(End of thread)
